atoms.text:
The first living thing appeared at the beginning of the Palaeozoic era 540000000 years ago.

The following Mesozoic era, which began about 250000000 years ago and ended 65000000 years ago, is also known as the age of the dinosaurs. It is divided into the Triassic, Jurassic and Cretaceous periods.

The Mesozoic era began with the Triassic period, followed by the Jurassic period 200000000 years ago and the Cretaceous period 136000000 years ago.
